messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw a support ticket where onboarding failed and the user got a generic 500 with body `{'error':'internal_error'}`. They had a bad API key. This is crushing DX, we need clearer surface and SDK exceptions.
kevin: Ugh. Can you paste the raw payload? is this hosted API or dedicated?
maria: Hosted. Raw body was:
```json
{"error":"internal_error","message":"something went wrong"}
```
No headers, no code. Customer tried rotating key and couldn't figure out why.
sam: That looks like our server-side catch-all. We swallow auth errors in some paths when upstream fails and return 500. Bug for sure.
maria: Proposal: return a structured error envelope, with stable fields we can map to SDK exceptions: `code`, `status`, `message`, `hint` and `request_id`. e.g.
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "authentication.invalid_api_key",
    "status": 401,
    "message": "API key invalid or expired",
    "hint": "Check REDWOOD_API_KEY in your environment or rotate the key in Console",
    "request_id": "req_01F..."
  }
}
```
kevin: love the `code` namespacing. For SDKs we should map `authentication.*` -> AuthenticationError, `rate_limit.*` -> RateLimitError with `retry_after` if set. Also include `status` to match HTTP.
olivia: From PM side we want friendly `hint` strings for onboarding docs + sample apps to surface. Can we standardize language so docs can pull it?
maria: Yes — hints should be short, actionable, and not leak internal infra. E.g., "Rotate API key in Console" rather than "your keystore expired".
sam: Question about status mapping: do we keep 500 for internal only? E.g. when provider runner OOMs we return 503 not 500? My take:
- 401: auth (invalid/expired token)
- 403: permission (customer not allowed)
- 404: model/route not found
- 429: rate limit / concurrency quota (include `retry_after`)
- 409: conflict (e.g., model version mismatch during rollout)
- 503: transient infra/unavailable (include `retryable: true`)
- 500: bug, not retryable, include `request_id`.
kevin: Agree. For SDK semantics, also expose flag `retryable` and `is_transient`. So higher-level retry policies can choose.
maria: Another ask: upstream error wrapping currently loses model logs. We should attach `error.details` as small structured list (max N chars) so SDK can surface concise cause. Example: `details:[{"type":"validation","message":"prompt too long"}]`
olivia: Important: security review on how much we return. Don't leak customer ids or model internals. Keep `details` sanitized.
kevin: On SDK names: propose common base `RedwoodError` with subclasses `AuthenticationError`, `AuthorizationError`, `RateLimitError`, `TransientServiceError`, `PermanentServiceError`, `ValidationError`. Each should include `code`, `status`, `request_id`, `hint`, `retry_after` (optional), and `raw` (the original JSON) for debugging.
maria: Also add a small migration plan in sample apps: show catch blocks for new typed exceptions, and example retry backoff for RateLimitError using `retry_after` or exponential fallback.
sam: I'll open a backend ticket to stop swallowing auth failures and implement structured envelope + status mapping. I'll include unit tests for mapping.
kevin: I'll prototype SDK exception types and add mapping layers in python/js/root. Quick sketch for JS: 
```js
class RedwoodError extends Error { constructor(payload){ super(payload.error.message); this.code = payload.error.code; this.status = payload.error.status; this.requestId = payload.error.request_id; this.hint = payload.error.hint; this.raw = payload; } }
class AuthenticationError extends RedwoodError {}
// mapping fn
function fromResponse(res){ const p = res.json(); switch(p.error.code.split('.')[0]){ case 'authentication': return new AuthenticationError(p); case 'rate_limit': return new RateLimitError(p); default: return new RedwoodError(p); } }
```
olivia: Can we add a small note in Console UX: when a key rotation fails surface the `hint` and link to key management page. Helps self-serve.
maria: For rolling out, we should keep backwards compatibility for a month: if caller expects old body, we still populate a minimal `error.message` plus the new envelope. Add a feature flag `structured_errors=v1` in headers for early adopters.
kevin: SDKs can opt-in to parsing with header `X-Redwood-Structured-Errors: 1`. Default will be legacy until we announce.
sam: deploy-bot: Deploy queued for patch branch `fix/structured-errors` — CI passed. :rocket:
maria: Thanks! After backend PR I'll add a devex sample app showing try/catch patterns, and a short onboarding blurb about how to interpret error codes.
kevin: I'll sync the exception names across repo and draft migration guide. Will ping SDK owners.
maria: Cool. Action items summarized:
- sam: backend PR to implement structured envelope + status mapping (ticket #1234).
- kevin: SDK exception prototypes + sample code snippets.
- olivia: update Console hint copy and docs.
- maria: sample apps + onboarding snippet.
(also add telemetry event for `error.code` to track top hits) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
